column1: # that inserts or un-deletes a child row without lockLiveParent on one of its
# soft-deletable/disableable parents in the same transaction.
# Columns: function <TAB> child <TAB> parent <TAB> reason <TAB> expires <TAB> added_by <TAB> reviewed_by
#   NO-CASCADE   the parent's delete path does not sweep, revoke or disable this child at
#                all, so a child created just after the delete ends in the same state as
#                one created just before: serial-equivalent for this class. (Whether the
#                missing cascade is itself a gap is a separate question.)
#   GATED-ON-USE the cascade does sweep it, but every consumer re-checks the parent's
#                liveness on use, so an orphan grants nothing.
#   TRANSITIVE   another parent's lock implies this one (the chain is stated).
#   SERIALIZED   caller and delete path share a named lock / row lock and re-check inside it.
#   PARENT-IS-SELF-RESTORE  an un-delete inside the parent's own restore transaction.
#   UNSAFE-OPEN  a real race; the issue tracks the fix. Remove the row when it lands.
#   pending: #N  an open PR fixes this site (expires; fails once #N has merged, see
#   arrives with #N  pre-registered for a site an open PR creates or renames.
